066/**
067 * UI component used for data navigation. It provides buttons for
068 * navigating forwards and backwards through a rowSet, displaying the current
069 * row number, commit and undo,
070 * re-fetch the rows in the rowSet from the database,
071 * insert and delete the displayed row, and display the number of records
072 * in the rowSet.
073 * <p>
074 * <img src="doc-files/ssdatanavigator.png" alt="SSDataNavigator image"
075 * style="display: inline-block; margin-left: 40px;">
076 * <br>or<br>
077 * <img src="doc-files/ssdatanavigator_2lines.png" alt="SSDataNavigator image"
078 * style="display: inline-block; margin-left: 40px;">
079 * <p>
080 * There are a variety of properties
081 * to control allowed actions on a RowSet, e.g.
082 * AllowInsert, AllowDelete, ...; see {@link RowsModel#setAllowInsert}, ...
083 * <p>
084 * For example if you are displaying three columns using the TextField and the
085 * user changes the text in the text fields then the columns will be updated to
086 * the new values when the user presses commit. If the user wants to
087 * revert the changes he made he can press the Undo button.
088 * <p>
089 * The enabled/disabled state of the buttons is dependent on the edit state
090 * of the SSComponents of the RowSet that the DataNavigator controls.
091 * Normally the navigation buttons are disabled if any field of the row is
092 * modified; either commit the row or undo the changes to allow navigation.
093 * If any field is in error, then only the undo button is enabled; or, of course,
094 * edit the field to remove the error.
095 */
096// NOTE: NavigateState.setAutoCommit() is not public and never referenced.
097// When auto commit mode is enabled, the navigation buttons remain enabled;
098// a navigation automatically commits any changes. Once navigation takes place
099// changes can't be reverted using Undo button (has to be done manually by the user).
100@SuppressWarnings("serial")
101public class SsDataNavigator extends JPanel {
102  /** The RowSet's actions/models for the buttons are in here. */
103  private RowsModel rowsModel;
104
105  /** This panel's original action map is the parent of any navActionMap. */
106  private final ActionMap parentActionMap;
107  private final ActionMap navActionMap;
108
109  /**
110   * The number of lines for the navigator.
111   */
112  public enum Lines { /** one line */ ONE, /** two line */ TWO }
113
114  /**
115   * Constructs the DataNavigator with the given RowsModel.
116   *
117   * @param rowsModel   the RowsModel to which the navigator is bound to
118   */
119  public SsDataNavigator(RowsModel rowsModel) {
120    this(rowsModel, Lines.ONE, null);
121  }
122
123  /**
124   * Constructs the DataNavigator with the given RowsModel.
125   *
126   * @param rowsModel   the RowsModel to which the navigator is bound to
127   * @param nLines      number of display lines for the navigator
128   */
129  public SsDataNavigator(RowsModel rowsModel, Lines nLines) {
130    this(rowsModel, nLines, null);
131  }
132
133  /**
134   * Constructs the DataNavigator with the given RowsModel
135   * and sets the size of the buttons on the navigator to the given size
136   *
137   * @param rowsModel   the RowsModel to which the navigator is bound to
138   * @param _buttonSize the size to which the button on navigator have to be set
139   */
140  public SsDataNavigator(RowsModel rowsModel, Dimension _buttonSize) {
141    this(rowsModel, Lines.ONE, _buttonSize);
142  }
143
144  /**
145   * Constructs the DataNavigator with the given RowsModel
146   * and sets the size of the buttons on the navigator to the given size
147   *
148   * @param rowsModel   the RowsModel to which the navigator is bound to
149   * @param _buttonSize the size to which the button on navigator have to be set
150   * @param nLines      number of display lines for the navigator
151   */
152  @SuppressWarnings({"LeakingThisInConstructor", "OverridableMethodCallInConstructor"})
153  public SsDataNavigator(RowsModel rowsModel, Lines nLines, Dimension _buttonSize) {
154    Objects.requireNonNull(rowsModel);
155    rowNumberSpinner = new RowNumberSpinner(rowsModel);
156    uiComponents = uiComponents();
157    uiButtons = uiButtons();
158    uiComponentsTop = uiComponentsTop();
159    uiComponentsBottom = uiComponentsBottom();
160
161    parentActionMap = getActionMap();
162    navActionMap = new ActionMap();
163    // Insert the navigate actions in front of the original actions.
164    navActionMap.setParent(parentActionMap);
165    setActionMap(navActionMap);
166
167    rowSpinnerSize = new Dimension(65, 20);
168    rowCountSize = new Dimension(80, 20);
169    buttonSize = _buttonSize == null ? new Dimension(40, 20) : _buttonSize;
170
171    rowNumberSpinner.removeTinyArrows(rowSpinnerSize);
172    rowNumberSpinner.setWindowUpDownKeysEnable(true);
173    rowNumberSpinner.addChangeListener((ChangeEvent e) -> { updateLblRowCount(); });
174
175    setRowsModel(rowsModel);
176    hideActionText(); // suppress the Action name from appearing next to the button icon.
177    setButtonSizes();
178    // For some reason the spinner text gets stretched, so nail it down.
179    rowNumberSpinner.setMaximumSize(rowSpinnerSize);
180    // lblRowCount.setFont(new Font("Dialog", Font.BOLD, 12));
181    // lblRowCount.setEditable(false);
182    // lblRowCount.setBorder(UIManager.getBorder("TextField.border"));
183
184    if (nLines == Lines.ONE)
185      createOneLineNavigator();
186    else
187      createTwoLineNavigator();
188  }
189
190  /**
191   * Set the navigator to use a different RowsModel ;
192   * swap in the new navigate ActionMap.
193   *
194   * @param rowsModel data for navigator
195   * @deprecated maybe temporarily, use RowsModel.setRowSet
196   */
197  // TODO: setModel(RowsModel)
198  // want this to be private
199  @Deprecated
200  protected void setRowsModel(RowsModel rowsModel) {
201    Objects.requireNonNull(rowsModel);
202    if (this.rowsModel != null)
203      throw new IllegalStateException("RowsModel already set");
204    this.rowsModel = rowsModel;
205
206    installRowsModel(rowsModel);
207  }
208
209  /**
210   * Set the navigator to use a different row set;
211   * swap in the new navigate ActionMap.
212   *
213   * @param RowsModel for navigator
214   */
215  private void installRowsModel(RowsModel rowsModel) {
216    // Fill Actions for the navigator with actions from the new rowsModel/RowSet.
217    rowsModel.fillNavActionMap(navActionMap);
218
219    // set the actions to the new navAction
220    firstButton.setAction(navActionMap.get(ACT_FIRST));
221    previousButton.setAction(navActionMap.get(ACT_PREVIOUS));
222    nextButton.setAction(navActionMap.get(ACT_NEXT));
223    lastButton.setAction(navActionMap.get(ACT_LAST));
224    commitButton.setAction(navActionMap.get(ACT_COMMIT));
225    undoButton.setAction(navActionMap.get(ACT_REVERT));
226    refreshButton.setAction(navActionMap.get(ACT_REFRESH));
227    addButton.setAction(navActionMap.get(ACT_ADD));
228    deleteButton.setAction(navActionMap.get(ACT_DELETE));
229
230    updateLblRowCount();
231  }
232
233  private void updateLblRowCount() {
234    Comparable<?> max = rowNumberSpinner.getModel().getMaximum();
235    lblRowCount.setText(max != null ? "of " + max : "");
236  }
237
238  /**
239   * Adds the navigator components to the navigator panel.
240   */
241  protected final void createOneLineNavigator() {
242    Box box = Box.createHorizontalBox();
243    uiComponents.forEach(uiItem -> box.add(uiItem));
244
245    // add buttons to the navigator
246    add(box);
247  }
248
249  /**
250   * Adds the navigator components to the navigator panel.
251   */
252  protected final void createTwoLineNavigator() {
253    // Create two horizontal boxes.
254    Box topBox = Box.createHorizontalBox();
255    uiComponentsTop.forEach(uiItem -> topBox.add(uiItem));
256
257    Box bottomBox = Box.createHorizontalBox();
258    uiComponentsBottom.forEach(uiItem -> bottomBox.add(uiItem));
259
260    Box box = Box.createVerticalBox();
261    box.add(topBox);
262    box.add(bottomBox);
263
264    box.setBorder(BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(
265        BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(2, 2, 2, 2),
266        BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(UIManager.getBorder("TitledBorder.border"),
267                                           BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(2, 2, 2, 2))));
268    // add buttons to the navigator
269    add(box);
270  }
271
272  /**
273   * Use the up/down arrow keys while this spinner's window is focused
274   * to adjust row number.
275   *
276   * @param enable true enables up/down keys when window has focus
277   */
278  public void setWindowUpDownKeysEnable(boolean enable) {
279    rowNumberSpinner.setWindowUpDownKeysEnable(enable);
280  }
281
282  // There used to be a bunch of "do*ButtonClick()" methods; not used anywhere.
283  // Could replace with "doButtonClick(RowsAction)" if needed for whatever.
284
285  /**
286   * Returns the size of buttons on the data navigator.
287   *
288   * @return returns a Dimension object representing the size of each button on
289   *         the data navigator.
290   */
291  // TODO: Dimension copy?
292  public Dimension getButtonSize() {
293    return buttonSize;
294  }
295
296  /**
297   * Return the RowsModel for this navigator.
298   * @return
299   */
300  public RowsModel getRowsModel() {
301    return rowsModel;
302  }
303
304  /**
305   * Prevent the navigator buttons from displaying the Action name with the icon.
306   */
307  private void hideActionText() {
308    uiButtons.forEach(uiItem -> uiItem.setHideActionText(true));
309  }
310
311  /**
312   * This will make all the components in the navigator to either focusable
313   * components or non focusable components. Set to false if you don't want any of
314   * the buttons or text fields in the navigator to receive the focus else true.
315   * The default value is true.
316   *
317   * @param focusable - false if you don't want the navigator to receive focus
318   *                  else false.
319   */
320  @Override
321  public void setFocusable(boolean focusable) {
322    uiButtons.forEach(uiItem -> uiItem.setFocusable(focusable));
323    rowNumberSpinner.setFocusable(focusable);
324  }
325
326  /**
327   * Sets the preferredSize and the MinimumSize of the buttons to the specified
328   * size
329   *
330   * @param _buttonSize the required dimension of the buttons
331   */
332  public void setButtonSize(Dimension _buttonSize) {
333    final Dimension oldValue = buttonSize;
334    buttonSize = _buttonSize;
335    firePropertyChange("buttonSize", oldValue, buttonSize);
336    setButtonSizes();
337  }
338
339  /**
340   * Sets the dimensions for the navigator components.
341   */
342  protected void setButtonSizes() {
343    uiButtons.forEach(uiItem -> uiItem.setPreferredSize(buttonSize));
344    rowNumberSpinner.setPreferredSize(rowSpinnerSize);
345    lblRowCount.setPreferredSize(rowCountSize);
346
347    lblRowCount.setHorizontalAlignment(SwingConstants.CENTER);
348
349    uiButtons.forEach(uiItem -> uiItem.setMinimumSize(buttonSize));
350    rowNumberSpinner.setMinimumSize(rowSpinnerSize);
351    lblRowCount.setMinimumSize(rowCountSize);
352  }
353
354  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
355  //
356  // Components/dimensions
357  //
358
359  /** Button to add a record to the RowSet. */
360  protected final JButton addButton = new JButton();
361
362  /** Button to commit screen changes to the RowSet. */
363  protected final JButton commitButton = new JButton();
364
365  /** Button to delete the current record in the RowSet. */
366  protected final JButton deleteButton = new JButton();
367
368  /** Button to navigate to the first record in the RowSet. */
369  protected final JButton firstButton = new JButton();
370
371  /** Button to navigate to the last record in the RowSet. */
372  protected final JButton lastButton = new JButton();
373
374  /** Button to navigate to the next record in the RowSet. */
375  protected final JButton nextButton = new JButton();
376
377  /** Button to navigate to the previous record in the RowSet. */
378  protected final JButton previousButton = new JButton();
379
380  /** Button to refresh the screen based on any changes to the RowSet. */
381  protected final JButton refreshButton = new JButton();
382
383  /** Button to revert screen changes based on the RowSet. */
384  protected final JButton undoButton = new JButton();
385
386  /** Navigator button dimensions. */
387  private Dimension buttonSize;
388
389  /** Label to display the total number of records in the RowSet. */
390  private final JLabel lblRowCount = new JLabel();
391  // private final JTextField lblRowCount = new JTextField();
392
393  /** Component for viewing/changing the current record number. */
394  protected final RowNumberSpinner rowNumberSpinner;
395
396  /** Current record spinner dimensions. */
397  private final Dimension rowSpinnerSize;
398  private final Dimension rowCountSize;
399
400  private final List<JComponent> uiComponents;
401  private final List<AbstractButton> uiButtons;
402  private final List<JComponent> uiComponentsTop;
403  private final List<JComponent> uiComponentsBottom;
404
405  /** These are added in order to this JPanel */
406  private List<JComponent> uiComponents() {
407    return List.of(firstButton, previousButton, rowNumberSpinner, nextButton, lastButton,
408                   commitButton, undoButton, refreshButton, addButton, deleteButton, lblRowCount);
409  }
410  private List<JComponent> uiComponentsTop() {
411    return List.of(firstButton, previousButton, rowNumberSpinner, nextButton, lastButton,
412                   lblRowCount);
413  }
414  private List<JComponent> uiComponentsBottom() {
415    return List.of(commitButton, undoButton, refreshButton, addButton, deleteButton);
416  }
417
418  /** The buttons can often be handled en masse */
419  private List<AbstractButton> uiButtons() {
420    return List.of(firstButton, previousButton, nextButton, lastButton, commitButton, undoButton,
421                   refreshButton, addButton, deleteButton);
422  }
423}
